source_title: Graduation, Dropout & Persistence Rate Technical Manual
archive_kind: paraphrase of complete official PDF web-reader text; not original PDF bytes

reviewed_sections: Accountability and Graduation Rate Calculation, page 15

paraphrase: The cohort stays with the student across transfers. Responsibility follows the last high school and LEA; graduation coding determines the last school for graduates. Non-graduate responsibility can persist after attendance ends. The final exit or year-end code assigns a student to graduate, non-graduate, or exited status. Verified diploma-school transfers remove former-school responsibility. Four-year status closes August 31 of the cohort year; FY2025 uses cohort2024. Calculation uses integrity-passing AzEDS records. The complete reader does not reproduce the older dual-graduation exception. This supports interpreting distinct-school outcomes as administrative responsibility sets, complemented by the May2025 one-graduation-code guidance. It does not establish physical residence or private-school coverage.
limitations: Original PDF requests returned HTTP403. Text-search absence concerns the complete reader, not an independently inspected PDF image.
